_: HAND-WRITTEN, and every `reviewed` is false until rux says otherwise. Holds only what cannot be derived: the purpose line, which slot is recommended, and the prose. Placement EVIDENCE is derived by builder/placement.mjs and is never written here. tools/check-blocks.mjs validates every block, slot and variant key against builder/blocks.json, and requires `evidence` on any suggestion whose recorded layout does not match the slot's. Purpose lines are docs/choices.md's own "Use it when" column, not new prose.

app-shell.purpose: Nav and header, nothing else yet — the shell a page starts from before it knows what it holds.

suggestions.reason: A shell with nothing in it needs a heading before it needs anything else, and this one carries its own actions.
suggestions.unless: The page has a page title already — the two are alternatives, not a pair.

suggestions.reason: Four numbers across is the fastest way to make an empty shell say what the page is about.
Tabs give a shell somewhere to put a second view without a second page.
suggestions.unless: There is only one view — tabs holding one panel read as a mistake.

suggestions.reason: A shell deep in a hierarchy wants a way back up.
suggestions.evidence: No template places a breadcrumb, and the fragment carries no grid ancestry: the spacing above the first block is unverified. docs/composing-pages.md §3.10.

dashboard-page.purpose: A few numbers and a table, read more than edited.

suggestions.reason: A single tile carries one figure that does not belong in the metric row.
suggestions.unless: It would sit inside anything painting layer — §3.1: a tile on layer-two is invisible on a plain page.
suggestions.evidence: The dashboard grid is its own layout and no block outside this template matches it. Placement here is unverified in both directions.

table-page.purpose: A list of records: sort, select, page.

suggestions.reason: Every table page needs the state where the query returns nothing.
suggestions.unless: The empty case is handled outside the page.

suggestions.reason: The load failed but the page did not — the error belongs above the table, not instead of it.
A second form, for a record that saves in two independent parts.
suggestions.unless: The two parts save together — one form with a fieldset each is the honest shape.

suggestions.reason: A validation summary above the fields, where a per-field message is not enough.
suggestions.evidence: No template places an inline notification in a form body: its spacing against the form below is unverified. §3.10.

suggestions.reason: A plain title, where the page header's actions are not wanted.
suggestions.unless: The page header is already there — they are alternatives.

suggestions.reason: A group of controls that save together, beside the ones already here.
Settings nobody changes belong behind a disclosure rather than on the page.
suggestions.evidence: No template places an accordion in a page body. Its own margins against a stack are unverified. §3.10.

wizard-page.purpose: One step of a multi-step flow.

suggestions.reason: A step that failed validation says so at the top of its own panel.
suggestions.evidence: The wizard grid carries css-grid--with-row-gap, which its source calls load-bearing below lg, so no block outside this template shares its layout. Placement here is unverified.

suggestions.reason: A read-only list of what the earlier steps collected, above the fields of this one.
suggestions.unless: The summary block is already saying that.
suggestions.evidence: Same as above: nothing outside this template matches the wizard panel's layout.

suggestions.reason: The details that go with the dates — who, what, and why — in the shape the form page attests.
A plain title where the schedule's own heading is not wanted.
suggestions.unless: The page title is already there.

suggestions.reason: Empty because something failed is a different message from empty because nothing has been made yet.
A table with its headings and no rows says what WILL be here, which an illustration cannot.
suggestions.unless: The empty table block is already doing that.

suggestions.reason: A failed load and an empty result look the same to a reader; the table shell keeps the shape.
Kept with the table when an error replaces its rows rather than the whole page.
suggestions.unless: The error replaced the table too — pagination over nothing is noise.
